sentences.sentence: Hydroxyzine is a prescription antihistamine used to treat anxiety and tension, itching from allergic skin conditions, and sedation before and after general anesthesia.
It comes in three oral forms:
Hydroxyzine hydrochloride (HCl) tablets in 10 mg, 25 mg, and 50 mg strengths
Hydroxyzine hydrochloride oral solution (a syrup) containing 10 mg in each 5 mL
Hydroxyzine pamoate capsules in 25 mg
There is also a hydroxyzine hydrochloride injection.
It is given into a muscle by a healthcare professional and is never given into a vein or under the skin.
Hydroxyzine is not chemically related to benzodiazepines, phenothiazines, reserpine, or meprobamate.
Hydroxyzine is thought to work by quieting activity in certain deeper regions of the brain, below the outer layer known as the cortex.
It is not a cortical depressant, meaning it does not work by slowing down the outer layer of the brain the way some other sedatives do.
Hydroxyzine also blocks histamine, a chemical your body releases during an allergic reaction.
This is what relieves itching.
Laboratory and clinical studies have also shown that hydroxyzine relaxes skeletal muscle, widens the airways (bronchodilation), and reduces pain.
These are effects that have been observed rather than uses the medicine is approved for.
Hydroxyzine has also been shown to reduce nausea and vomiting.
This is an approved use for the injection, but not for the forms taken by mouth.
Take hydroxyzine exactly as your doctor prescribes.
Follow all directions on your prescription label.
Do not take more or less than prescribed, and do not take it for longer than your doctor tells you to.
Your doctor may adjust your dose depending on how well you respond to treatment.
If you are taking the oral solution, measure your dose with the dosing syringe provided, a dose-measuring spoon, or a medicine cup.
Do not use a kitchen spoon, because it will not give an accurate dose.
Ask your pharmacist for a measuring device if you do not have one.
Call your doctor if your anxiety does not improve or if it gets worse.

sentences.section_title: What is the usual dosage of hydroxyzine?
sentences.sentence: The dose depends on what you are being treated for.

sentences.section_title: What is the usual dosage of hydroxyzine?
sentences.sentence: The same doses apply to hydroxyzine hydrochloride tablets, hydroxyzine hydrochloride oral solution, and hydroxyzine pamoate capsules.

sentences.section_title: What is the usual dosage of hydroxyzine?
sentences.sentence: Adults: 50 to 100 mg four times a day

sentences.section_title: What is the usual dosage of hydroxyzine?
sentences.sentence: Children under 6 years: 50 mg a day, split into smaller doses

sentences.sentence: Children 6 years and over: 50 to 100 mg a day, split into smaller doses

sentences.sentence: Doctors usually start older adults on a low dose.

sentences.section_title: What is the usual dosage of hydroxyzine?
sentences.sentence: Sedating medicines can cause confusion and too much sedation in older people, so your doctor will watch you closely.

sentences.section_title: What is the usual dosage of hydroxyzine?
sentences.sentence: Kidney, liver, and heart function often decline with age, and how much hydroxyzine leaves the body through the kidneys has not been established.

sentences.section_title: What are the side effects of hydroxyzine?
sentences.sentence: The most common side effects of hydroxyzine are drowsiness, dry mouth, and headache.

sentences.section_title: What are the side effects of hydroxyzine?
sentences.sentence: These are usually mild and do not last long.

sentences.section_title: What are the side effects of hydroxyzine?
sentences.sentence: A skin rash is different.

sentences.section_title: What are the side effects of hydroxyzine?
sentences.sentence: If you develop a rash while taking hydroxyzine, stop taking it and call your doctor, because a rash can be the first sign of a serious reaction.

sentences.section_title: What are the side effects of hydroxyzine?
sentences.sentence: Common hydroxyzine side effects include dry mouth, headache, and drowsiness.

sentences.section_title: What are the side effects of hydroxyzine?
sentences.sentence: The drowsiness is usually temporary and may go away after a few days of treatment or when the dose is lowered.

sentences.section_title: What are the side effects of hydroxyzine?
sentences.sentence: Stop taking hydroxyzine and call your doctor right away if you develop a skin rash, if a skin condition you are treating gets worse, or if you have any other sign of an allergic reaction.

sentences.section_title: What are the side effects of hydroxyzine?
sentences.sentence: In rare cases, hydroxyzine can cause a serious skin reaction called acute generalized exanthematous pustulosis (AGEP).

sentences.section_title: What are the side effects of hydroxyzine?
sentences.sentence: Signs include fever together with many small, shallow, pus-filled spots appearing across large areas of swollen, red skin.

sentences.section_title: What are the side effects of hydroxyzine?
sentences.sentence: If you have had AGEP or another allergic reaction to hydroxyzine, you should also avoid cetirizine and levocetirizine, because a similar reaction can happen with those medicines.

sentences.section_title: What are the side effects of hydroxyzine?
sentences.sentence: Hydroxyzine has also been linked to a heart rhythm problem called QT prolongation, which can lead to a serious irregular heartbeat known as Torsade de Pointes.

sentences.section_title: What are the side effects of hydroxyzine?
sentences.sentence: Other reported side effects include:

sentences.section_title: What are the side effects of hydroxyzine?
sentences.sentence: tremor or seizures (convulsions), which are rare and have usually happened at doses much higher than recommended

sentences.section_title: What are the side effects of hydroxyzine?
sentences.sentence: hallucinations (seeing or hearing things that are not there)

sentences.section_title: What are the side effects of hydroxyzine?
sentences.sentence: skin reactions including rash, hives, itching, and fixed drug eruptions, which are rashes that come back in the same spot each time the medicine is taken

sentences.section_title: What are the side effects of hydroxyzine?
sentences.sentence: allergic reaction

sentences.section_title: What are the side effects of hydroxyzine?
sentences.sentence: Serious breathing problems have not been reported at recommended doses.

sentences.section_title: What are the side effects of hydroxyzine?
sentences.sentence: If you are given hydroxyzine by injection, tell your healthcare provider straight away about severe pain, swelling, or skin changes where the injection was given.

sentences.section_title: What are the side effects of hydroxyzine?
sentences.sentence: In rare cases, the injection has caused serious damage to the surrounding tissue, including tissue death (necrosis) and gangrene, which has needed surgery to treat.

sentences.section_title: What are the side effects of hydroxyzine?
sentences.sentence: This is not a complete list of side effects, and others may happen.

sentences.section_title: What are the side effects of hydroxyzine?
sentences.sentence: Call your doctor for medical advice about side effects.

sentences.section_title: What are the side effects of hydroxyzine?
sentences.sentence: You may report side effects to the FDA at 1-800-FDA-1088.
Do not take hydroxyzine if you:
are allergic to hydroxyzine or to any ingredient in the medicine
are allergic to cetirizine or levocetirizine
have a prolonged QT interval, a heart rhythm finding seen on an electrocardiogram (ECG)
are in early pregnancy
In animal studies, hydroxyzine caused birth defects in rats and mice at doses well above those used in people.
There is not enough information in humans to know whether hydroxyzine is safe in early pregnancy, so it should not be used at that time.

sentences.section_title: What should I avoid while taking hydroxyzine?
sentences.sentence: Hydroxyzine can make you drowsy.

sentences.section_title: What should I avoid while taking hydroxyzine?
sentences.sentence: Do not drive or operate dangerous machinery until you know how it affects you.

sentences.section_title: What should I avoid while taking hydroxyzine?
sentences.sentence: Avoid alcohol and other medicines that cause drowsiness.
Hydroxyzine makes the effects of central nervous system depressants stronger.
If you take hydroxyzine with any of the following, your doctor may need to lower the dose of the other medicine:
narcotic (opioid) pain medicines
non-narcotic pain medicines
barbiturates
Hydroxyzine may increase the effects of meperidine and barbiturates when used before anesthesia, so your doctor will adjust these doses for you individually.
Care is needed if you take other medicines that can affect heart rhythm by prolonging the QT interval.
These include:
heart rhythm medicines such as quinidine, procainamide, amiodarone, and sotalol
certain antipsychotics such as ziprasidone, iloperidone, clozapine, quetiapine, and chlorpromazine
certain antidepressants such as citalopram and fluoxetine
certain antibiotics such as azithromycin, erythromycin, clarithromycin, gatifloxacin, and moxifloxacin
other medicines such as pentamidine, methadone, ondansetron, and droperidol
Hydroxyzine does not affect atropine or other belladonna alkaloids, and it is not known to interfere with digitalis.
It can be used at the same time as digitalis.
Tell each of your healthcare providers about all medicines you take, including prescription and over-the-counter medicines, vitamins, and herbal products.
Not all possible interactions are listed here.

sentences.section_title: What happens if I overdose on hydroxyzine?
sentences.sentence: Seek emergency medical attention or call the Poison Help line at 1-800-222-1222.

sentences.section_title: What happens if I overdose on hydroxyzine?
sentences.sentence: The most common sign of hydroxyzine overdose is heavy sedation.

sentences.section_title: What happens if I overdose on hydroxyzine?
sentences.sentence: Other reported signs include seizures (convulsions), stupor, nausea, and vomiting.

sentences.section_title: What happens if I overdose on hydroxyzine?
sentences.sentence: Overdose can also cause QT prolongation and Torsade de Pointes, so heart monitoring with an ECG is recommended.

sentences.section_title: What happens if I overdose on hydroxyzine?
sentences.sentence: There is no specific antidote for hydroxyzine overdose.
